comparison.objective: Align a prosthetic foot 30 mm ahead of a laser line with 5-degree toe-out; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Macroscopic translational and angular fixture alignment versus recessed coaxial tool placement, impact regulation, withdrawal, and tiny-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Foot reaches the stated 30 mm and 5-degree alignment versus four safe fractures with full fragment containment and intact hardware. Acceptable measurement tolerances are not provided.
comparison.reason: Geometric bench alignment does not test impact-driven insert finishing.
